statistics.description: Number of GEN instructions in the final generated shader executable.

statistics.description: Number of basic blocks in the final generated shader executable. The number correspond the number of control flow instructions.

statistics.name: Scratch Memory Size
statistics.description: Number of bytes of scratch memory required by the generated shader executable. If this is non-zero, you may want to adjust your shader to reduce register pressure.

statistics.name: Loop Count
statistics.description: Number of active loops (not unrolled) in the final generated shader executable.

statistics.name: Workgroup Memory Size
statistics.description: Number of bytes of workgroup shared memory including any padding.
